verdict.rationale: cubic runs unattended as a GitHub App. It automatically reviews every new PR, can auto-fix issues from each review, and can auto-approve low-risk PRs, so it works as automation in the PR pipeline without human interaction. Its documented CLI, however, is framed as a local pre-push review tool that hands a prompt to a coding agent, with no documented headless or CI mode. Missing for 10: a documented non-interactive or headless CLI mode, an official CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Actions step or pipeline example), CI exit-code or gating semantics, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
